prompt:
plan.json is the pending Terraform plan for production (terraform show -json of the plan file), made from the .tf files in this directory with their default variable values and no tfvars file. Before it is applied, edit the .tf files so that the plan destroys or replaces no existing resource:
- for every resource the plan replaces, find the configuration change that forces the replacement and set that value back to the one the resource has now (its value before the change);
- for every resource the plan deletes, change the configuration so that it stays.
Keep every other change the plan makes: in-place updates and new resources stay as they are. Do not remove or rename resources, do not add lifecycle blocks, moved blocks or tfvars files, and do not edit plan.json or versions.tf. Terraform and the AWS provider are not available here: do not run terraform. Finish when the .tf files would plan no delete and no replace.
solution:
/usr/bin/python3 -I -c 'def sub(p, a, b):
    s = open(p).read(); assert s.count(a) == 1, (p, a); open(p, "w").write(s.replace(a, b))
sub("main.tf", "identifier              = \"acme-production\"", "identifier              = \"acme-prod\"")
sub("main.tf", "bucket = \"acme-prod-assets\"", "bucket = \"acme-assets-prod\"")
sub("variables.tf", "type    = number\n  default = 2", "type    = number\n  default = 3")
'
control: - Read plan.json, the output of `terraform show -json` for the pending plan.
squeeze: - Run `squeeze < plan.json` and read squeeze's output instead of the plan JSON.
